2024 is a leap year, but 1638 is not.  
252 days from 2024-02-20 would be 2024-10-28 (leap year).  
1638 is not a leap year, so February has 28 days.  
Days in months after Feb 1638: Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31.  

From 1638-02-20:  
Feb: 8 days left (28–20) → 8 days used.  
Mar: 31 → total 39 days.  
Apr: 30 → total 69 days.  
May: 31 → total 100 days.  
Jun: 30 → total 130 days.  
Jul: 31 → total 161 days.  
Aug: 31 → total 192 days.  
Sep: 30 → total 222 days.  
Oct: need 30 more days (252–222=30) → Oct 30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1638-10-30
